description: This file defines internal data structures and methods for managing pages within a database engine, including page types, elements, and utilities for handling page data and page IDs.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: Represents a page in the database with methods to identify type, access elements, and manipulate page properties.

classes.name: branchPageElement
classes.description: Represents a node on a branch page, including position, key size, and page ID.

classes.name: leafPageElement
classes.description: Represents a node on a leaf page, including flags, position, key size, and value size.

classes.name: PageInfo
classes.description: Provides human-readable information about a page.

classes.name: Pgids
classes.description: A slice of page IDs with methods for length, comparison, and merging.

methods.name: NewPage
methods.description: Creates a new Page instance with specified id, flags, count, and overflow.

methods.name: Page.Typ
methods.description: Returns a string representing the page type for debugging.

methods.name: Page.IsBranchPage
methods.description: Checks if the page is a branch page.

methods.name: Page.IsLeafPage
methods.description: Checks if the page is a leaf page.

methods.name: Page.IsMetaPage
methods.description: Checks if the page is a meta page.

methods.name: Page.IsFreelistPage
methods.description: Checks if the page is a freelist page.

methods.name: Page.Meta
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the metadata section of the page.

methods.name: Page.FastCheck
methods.description: Performs assertions to verify page id and type.

methods.name: Page.LeafPageElement
methods.description: Retrieves a leaf node element by index.

methods.name: Page.LeafPageElements
methods.description: Retrieves all leaf node elements.

methods.name: Page.BranchPageElement
methods.description: Retrieves a branch node element by index.

methods.name: Page.BranchPageElements
methods.description: Retrieves all branch node elements.

methods.name: Page.FreelistPageCount
methods.description: Returns the count of freelist pages and index.

methods.name: Page.FreelistPageIds
methods.description: Returns a slice of freelist page IDs.

methods.name: Page.hexdump
methods.description: Outputs page data as hex to STDERR.

methods.name: Page.PageElementSize
methods.description: Returns size of page element based on page type.

methods.name: Page.Id
methods.description: Returns the page ID.

methods.name: Page.SetId
methods.description: Sets the page ID.

methods.name: Page.Flags
methods.description: Returns the page flags.

methods.name: Page.SetFlags
methods.description: Sets the page flags.

methods.name: Page.Count
methods.description: Returns the count of elements on the page.

methods.name: Page.SetCount
methods.description: Sets the count of elements on the page.

methods.name: Page.Overflow
methods.description: Returns the overflow count.

methods.name: Page.SetOverflow
methods.description: Sets the overflow count.

methods.name: Page.String
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the page.

methods.name: Pgids.Len
methods.description: Returns the number of page IDs.

methods.name: Pgids.Swap
methods.description: Swaps two page IDs.

methods.name: Pgids.Less
methods.description: Compares two page IDs.

methods.name: Pgids.Merge
methods.description: Returns a sorted union of two Pgids slices.

methods.name: Mergepgids
methods.description: Merges two sorted Pgids slices into a destination slice.
